blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform event-level video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)已作为一门重要的通俗主义机器人政策而出现,旨在将视频预测前科转移至行动学习. 然而,我们发现,现有的WAM经常在开放环境中产生不正确的运动预测,导致错误的行动. 我们将此限制归因于两个因素:(1)基础视频模型不为被操纵所优化,(2)天真地将动作元件纳入视频模型可以大幅度地降低其通化能力. 我们引入了视频预测政策2(VPP2),这是一种WAM,它能够在视频预测和动作生成中实现强烈的零镜头通缩. 首先,我们整理一套大规模,多样的操纵视频数据集,继续预先训练基础视频基础模型. 并进行事件层面的视频预训, 其次,我们经过训练后,把视频模型蒸馏成一个具有固定预测视野的单步视觉规划器. 最后,我们通过转换器混合结构引入动作模块,以学习隐含的反向动态模型。 实验显示有三项关键结果:(1)VPP2-14B在视频预测指令中Cosmos3-64B比开放式任务的成功率高出11.0%;(2)VPP2在现实世界的无镜头ALOHA操纵任务中超过最强基准18.5%的成功率;和(3)在针对基准的训练后,VPP2在具有挑战性的LIBERO-Pro,LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo基准上取得了最高的成功率.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) are developing rapidly and have become an important class of generalist robot policies ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; AgiBot Research Team et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Many WAMs build on video foundation models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , aiming to transfer their rich priors about physical dynamics to policy learning. This premise is compelling: accurate, instruction-conditioned video predictions can guide action generation through an explicit or implicit inverse dynamics model ( Du et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) . However, prior work ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) has found that existing WAMs often perform well only on a narrow set of seen tasks, while producing unreliable future motion predictions in unseen, out-of-distribution scenarios. These prediction failures, in turn, lead to erroneous actions. In recent benchmarks that require generalization, robot policies, including WAMs, with near-perfect success rates on standard evaluation suites suffer substantial performance drops under perturbed task configurations and novel skill compositions ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Li, 2025 ; Mishra et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)正在迅速发展,并已成为通俗主义机器人政策的重要类别(Hu等,2024;Liao等,2025;Kim等,2026;Yuan等,2026;Ma等,2026;Li等,2026a;Li等,2026b;AgiBot Research). Team等,2026; Ye等,2026.). 许多WAM基于视频基础模型(Wan等人,2025年;Agarwal等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年),旨在将他们丰富的物理动力学前科转移到政策学习上. 这个前提很有说服力:准确的,带指令条件的视频预测可以通过一个明示或暗示的反向动态模型来指导动作生成(Du等,2023;Hu等,2024.). 然而,前作(张等,2026b. )发现,现有的WAM往往只在狭义的一组可见到的任务上表现良好,同时在隐蔽,分流外的情景下产生不可靠的未来运动预测. 这些预测的失败反过来导致错误的行动。 在近期需要概括化的基准中,包括WAM在内的机器人政策,在标准评价套件上取得了近乎完美的成功,但在扰动的任务配置和新技能构成下,其性能大幅下降(周等,2025;李等,2025;米什拉等,2026)。

blocks.en: We identify two key factors that limit the generalization of existing WAMs to unseen scenarios. First, base video models are primarily optimized for creative content generation and aesthetic quality rather than precise physical dynamics, and therefore often fail to follow manipulation instructions faithfully ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Second, introducing action-specific components or training objectives into pretrained video foundation models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities ( Mishra et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们查明了两个关键因素,这些因素将现有武器监测机制的概括性限制在不可见的情况下。 一,基本视频模式主要优化为创意内容生成和美学质量,而非精确的物理动态,因此往往不忠实地遵循操纵指令(Chen等,2025;张等,2026b. 其次,将特定行动部分或培训目标引入经过预先培训的视频基础模型,可大幅降低其通缩能力(Mishra等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: To address these issues, we introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that achieves strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. Our first objective is to train a generalizable video foundation that can faithfully follow instruction and make future predictions grounded in the current observation, without unsupported changes to the scene or task. To this end, we annotate each clip with a detailed caption specifying the manipulation process, active end effector, and target object, and perform event-level video prediction training. As illustrated in Figure 1 , detailed captions and complete event-level trajectory prediction substantially reduce uncertainty in future prediction and encourage consistent mappings from semantic descriptions to visual trajectories, improving generalization across diverse instructions. We then post-train the video model to predict fixed-horizon future chunks and apply consistency distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ) to obtain a single-step visual planner for real-time robot execution. Finally, we introduce an action expert through a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture ( Liang et al., 2025 ) to learn an implicit inverse dynamics model conditioned on the predicted future. During policy execution, we pair VPP2 with a VLM planner ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Bytedance Seed, 2026 ) that translates open-ended instructions into explicit subtask instructions.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了视频预测政策2(VPP2),这个WAM在视频预测和动作生成上都实现了强烈的零镜头概括. 我们的第一个目标是训练一个能忠实地听从指示的通俗的视频基础,并根据目前的观察来作出未来的预测,而不支持场景或任务的变化. 为此,我们对每个片段进行注释,并附有详细的字幕来说明操纵过程、活性终端效应器和目标对象,并进行事件级视频预测培训。 如图1所示,详细的标题和完整的事件级轨迹预测会大大减少未来预测中的不确定性,并鼓励从语义描述到视觉轨迹的一致绘图,使各种指示更加概括。 随后我们再对视频模型进行后培训,以预测固定视距未来块并应用一致性分馏(Song等,2023年),以获得用于实时机器人执行的单步视觉规划器. 最后,我们通过一个转换器混合结构(Liang等,2025年)引入一名行动专家,以学习以预测未来为条件的隐含反向动态模型。 在政策执行期间,我们把VPP2与VLM规划器(Bai等,2025;Bytedance Seed,2026)配对,将开放式指令转化为明确的子任务指令.

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate three key advantages of VPP2. (1) VPP2-14B follows manipulation instructions faithfully, outperforming Cosmos3-64B ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) by 11% in instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks. (2) VPP2 exhibits strong zero-shot manipulation capabilities on a real-world ALOHA platform ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , achieving an average success rate of 58.5% across 10 task categories, compared with 40.0% for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) and 20.5% for Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . (3) Following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on LIBERO-Pro ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) (45.0%, compared with 11.0% for the strongest baseline), LIBERO-OOD ( Li, 2025 ; Mishra et al., 2026 ) (63.9%), and RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) (29.47%, state-of-the-art).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验展示了VPP2的三大优势. (1) VPP2-14B忠实地遵循了操纵指令,在无限制任务的指令成功率方面比Cosmos3-64B(Agarwal等,2026年)高11%。 (2) VPP2在现实世界的ALOHA平台上展现出强大的零发操纵能力(赵等,2023年),在10个任务类别中平均成功率达到58.5%,而 0.5\pi_{0.5} (Intelligence等人,2025年)和快取WAM的20.5%(袁等,2026年). (3)按照具体基准的后培训,VPP2在LIBERO-Pro(周等,2025年)(最强基线为11.0%),LIBERO-OOD(Li,2025年;Mishra等,2026年)(63.9%)和RoboDojo(Chen等,2026年)(29.47%,最先进水平)的评价方法中取得了最高的成功率。

blocks.en: 2 Data Process Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2 数据处理 管道

blocks.en: In this section, we describe our data collection and curation pipeline, including how we unify the inputs and outputs across diverse manipulation datasets.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍我们的数据收集和目录程序,包括我们如何统一各种操纵数据集的投入和产出。

blocks.en: Video Sources. We compile a large-scale, diverse collection of manipulation videos for continued pretraining of an open-source video foundation model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . Our data span three categories: robot manipulation datasets, human activity datasets, and general-purpose video datasets. For general-purpose video datasets, we apply an extensive filtering pipeline similar to that of LVP ( Chen et al., 2025 ) to retain only videos depicting manipulation-related activities. Table 1 summarizes the datasets used for training.
blocks.zh: 视频来源. 我们汇编了大规模、多样化的操纵视频,以继续预训开源视频基础模型(Wan等,2025年)。 我们的数据分为三类:机器人操纵数据集、人类活动数据集和通用视频数据集。 对于通用视频数据集,我们采用了类似于LVP(Chen等,2025年)的广泛过滤管,只保留了描述与操纵有关的活动的视频. 表1汇总了用于培训的数据集。

blocks.en: Table 1: We use various types of manipulation datasets and perform different filtering strategy for different datasets to ensure diversity and high-quality.
blocks.zh: 表1:我们使用各种类型的操纵数据集,对不同的数据集执行不同的过滤策略,以确保多样性和高质量.

blocks.en: Video Filtering, Segmentation and Captioning. We first remove corrupted trajectories, including those with camera failures or abrupt discontinuities, and segment the remaining trajectories into semantically coherent clips lasting 1–12 seconds. We identify candidate boundaries using heuristic cues associated with natural transitions, such as local minima in human-hand or end-effector velocity and moments when the gripper or fingers open or close. A vision-language model (VLM) then refines the segmentation by merging adjacent clips where appropriate and adjusting their start and end points.
blocks.zh: 视频过滤,分片和字幕. 我们首先去除腐烂的轨迹,包括那些有相机故障或突然中断的轨迹,并将所剩轨迹分解为长达一至十二秒的精密连贯的相片。 我们利用与自然过渡有关的热能提示来确定候选边界,例如人手或最终效应速度的局部微分,以及握手或手指打开或关闭的瞬间。 然后,一个视觉语言模型(VLM)通过酌情合并相邻的片段并调整其起端点来细化分化.

blocks.en: After segmentation, we generate detailed captions that describe the task, explicitly identify the active end effectors, unambiguously specify the target objects, and characterize the camera views and motion. Figure 2 illustrates an example, and Appendix A.1 provides further details.
blocks.zh: 分出后,我们生成详细的字幕来描述任务,明确识别活端效应器,明确指定目标对象,并描述相机的视图和运动. 图2说明了一个例子,附录A.1提供了进一步的细节。

blocks.en: Figure 2: An example of our data process pipeline. The central objective is to reduce uncertainty in future prediction, thereby encouraging the model to learn a consistent mapping from conditioning information to sub-task trajectories. To this end, each caption includes detailed task descriptions, explicit End-Effector Identification, visible target object, and camera-view changes.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们的数据流程流程实例。 中心目标是减少未来预测中的不确定性,从而鼓励模型学习从调制信息到子任务轨迹的一致绘图. 为此,每个标题包括详细的任务描述,明确的"最终效果识别",可见的目标对象,以及相机-视图的更改.

blocks.en: Unified T-shape Multi-view Input across Datasets. Robotics datasets commonly contain observations from multiple camera views. We arrange them into a T-shaped composite image, with the primary view on the left and two auxiliary views stacked vertically on the right, as illustrated in the bottom-left panel of Figure 2 . When fewer than two auxiliary views are available, we fill the missing slots with black placeholder images.
blocks.zh: 跨数据集的统一T-形状多视图输入. 机器人数据集通常包含来自多相机视图的观测. 我们把它们排列成一个T形的复合图像,左边是主视图,右边是垂直堆放的两个辅助视图,如图2的从下到左的面板所示。 当仅有不到两个辅助视图时,我们用黑色占位符图像来填充缺失的空档.

blocks.en: Unified Action Space and Unified End-effector Coordinate Systems. Different robot datasets often adopt inconsistent coordinate systems and camera viewpoints, resulting in conflicting action representations for visually similar motions. For example, a leftward motion may correspond to the positive x x -direction in one dataset but the negative y y -direction in another, making it difficult for the model to learn the semantic meaning of each action dimension.
blocks.zh: 统一行动空间和统一终端效应坐标系统。 不同的机器人数据集往往采用不一致的坐标系统和相机视角,导致视觉上相近运动的动作表示相冲突. 例如,左向运动可能与一个数据集中的正x-方向对应,而另一个数据集中的负y-方向对应,使得模型难以学习每个动作维度的语义意义.

blocks.en: 3 VPP2: A Generalist Policy with Zero-shot Capability
blocks.zh: 3 VPP2: 有零射能的通则政策

blocks.en: Overview. Our large-scale, diverse, and densely annotated dataset enables us to train a policy with strong generalization capabilities. VPP2 builds upon the pretrained Wan2.1-I2V-14B model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and introduce a action expert via mixture-of-transformers(MoT) architecture ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . Our training objective is twofold: we first adapt the video model to produce generalizable future predictions at real-time inference speed for open-ended manipulation tasks, and then train the action expert conditioned on the KV cache of the video model. To maximize policy generalization, we organize training into the stages summarized in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 概览. 我们的大规模、多样化和内容繁多的数据集使我们能够培训一项具有强大通俗化能力的政策。 VPP2以经过预先培训的Wan2.1-I2V-14B模型为基础(Wan等,2025年),并引入了一位动作专家,通过转录器(MoT)混合结构(Liang等,2025年). 我们的训练目标是双重的:我们首先调整了视频模型,以实时推导速度产生一般的未来预测,用于开放式的操纵任务,然后以视频模型的KV缓存为条件培训动作专家. 为了最大限度地普及政策,我们将培训组织到图4概述的各个阶段。

blocks.en: 3.2 Action Modeling

blocks.en: Stage 3: Action Pretraining across Datasets. After training a generalizable video model, we start training action on our processed bimanual datasets with unified workspace and eef coordinate systems. The action expert is a 0.9B-parameter diffusion transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) with standard MoT architecture. Since the action expert is newly initialized, we freeze the base parameters of the video DiT during the early stages of action training and adapt the video backbone using only LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . This strategy helps preserve the pretrained video representations while limiting disruption from action-training gradients.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:跨越数据集的行动预训。 在培训了一个通用的视频模型之后,我们开始就经过处理的双人数据集开展培训行动,这些数据集具有统一的工作空间和eef坐标系统。 动作专家为0.9B参数扩散变压器(DiT)(Peebles and Xie,2023年),有标准MOT架构. 由于动作专家是新初始化的,因此我们在动作训练初期冻结了视频DiT的基础参数,并仅使用LORA(Hu等,2022年)来调整视频主干线. 这项战略有助于保留经过预先培训的视频展示,同时限制对行动训练梯度的干扰。

blocks.en: Inference Latency. We can generate video very fast since we reduce the video input to 17 × 416 × 240 17\times 416\times 240 in post-training and distill the video model to enable one-step generation as described in Sec. 3.1 . With bfloat16 precision and torch.compile, video model part takes approximately 0.12 seconds. The action expert then generates an action chunk conditioned on the video latents using five denoising steps, taking approximately 0.1 seconds. The total latency per action chunk is therefore approximately 0.22 seconds.

blocks.en: 3.3 VLM for High-level Planning.
blocks.zh: 3.3 高级别规划的VLM。

blocks.en: Sub-task Planning. To tackle long-horizon tasks and handle ambiguous human instructions, we adopt a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM generates subtask plans ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . The VLM handles high-level reasoning, semantic understanding, and memory, allowing VPP2 to focus on mapping explicit instructions to trajectories. In practice, the VLM can be deployed locally or accessed through an API to a frontier model.
blocks.zh: 分任务规划. 为了完成长期任务和处理模棱两可的人类指令,我们采用了一种分级结构,其中一个VLM生成子任务计划(Shi等人,2025年)。 VLM处理高层次的推理,语义理解和内存,使VPP2能够专注于向轨迹绘制明确的指令. 实际上,VLM可以在当地部署,也可以通过API进入前沿模型.

blocks.en: Prompt Enhancement. Another function of VLM planning is to generate detailed subtask similar to template prompt during training caption. Also, model video generation models also find that detailed caption is essential for generation quality ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 即时增强. VLM规划的另一个功能是生成详细子任务,类似于培训标题时的模板提示. 此外,模型视频生成模型还发现,详细标题对生成质量至关重要(Wan等,2025;Yang等,2025)。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we conduct experiments to answer the following questions:
(1) How does the motion quality of VPP2’s video predictions compare with that of state-of-the-art video foundation models on manipulation tasks?
(2) How broad are VPP2’s zero-shot manipulation capabilities?
(3) How well does VPP2 perform after domain-specific post-training?
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们进行实验,以回答下列问题:
(1)VPP2的视频预测的运动质量如何与关于操纵任务的先进视频基础模型相比?
(2)VPP2的零发操纵能力有多大?
(3)VPP2在具体域后培训后的表现如何?

blocks.en:
Video Prediction for Human and Robot Manipulation. Figure 5 visualizes predictions for human-hand manipulation and diverse robot embodiments from pretrained VPP2 model. To assess generalization, we randomly sample test cases from prior work ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) and take photographs in office environments and robot workspaces, pairing them with freely chosen manipulation instructions.
Trained on data spanning more than 20 robot embodiments, VPP2 also generalizes to unseen embodiments and tasks, as shown in Figure 5 . VPP2 also supports joint prediction across one to three camera views, with the primary view placed on the left and up to two auxiliary views stacked on the right.

blocks.en: Quantitative Comparisons. We compare VPP2 with four video foundation models and one ablation variant: (1) Wan-2.1-I2V-14B-480p ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , our base model; (2) LVP ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , which also adapts Wan-2.1-I2V-14B-480p to manipulation tasks; (3) Cosmos3-Nano-16B, which is extensively trained on robot manipulation data; (4) Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video-64B, the strongest model in the Cosmos 3 family ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) ; and (5) VPP2-Fixed-Step, an ablation of our method that predicts a fixed-duration future chunk rather than a complete event, potentially misaligning the predicted future with the instruction describing the full event.
blocks.zh: 量比较. 我们比较了VPP2和四个视频基站模型和一个通缩变体: (1)Wan-2.1-I2V-14B-480p(Wan等,2025年),我们的基模;(2)LVP(Chen等,2025年),也将Wan-2.1-I2V-14B-480p调整为操纵任务;(3)Cosmos3-Nano-16B,广泛接受机器人操纵数据培训;(4)Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video-64B,宇宙3家族最强的模型(Agarwal等,2026年);和(5)VPP2-Fixed-Step,这是我们方法的缩写,它预言未来固定的块而不是一个完整的事件,有可能将预言的未来与描述全事件的指示错配.

blocks.en: We randomly collect 50 image–instruction pairs each for human-hand and robot manipulation and generate video predictions for every pair using each model. We first use a GPT-based evaluator to assess instruction-following success rates, reported in Table 2 . Human evaluators then compare pairs of predictions to determine which better follows the instruction, yielding VPP2’s pairwise win rates against each baseline in Figure 6 . VPP2’s advantages are most pronounced in complex manipulation scenarios requiring spatial understanding, as illustrated in Figure 7 . We hypothesize that training with detailed captions encourages more accurate mappings from instructions to trajectories, contributing to these improvements.

blocks.en: LIBERO-ID, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-OOD Benchmarks. All models are trained exclusively on the four standard LIBERO suites ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and are evaluated under three complementary settings. LIBERO-ID measures standard in-distribution manipulation performance. To assess generalization beyond the training distribution, we further evaluate on LIBERO-Pro ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) and LIBERO-OOD ( Li, 2025 ) without additional training. Following HarnessVLA ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , we evaluate the Position and Task perturbations of LIBERO-Pro, which test generalization to changes in object positions and task specifications, respectively. We further follow ( Mishra et al., 2026 ) to evaluate compositional generalization on LIBERO-OOD, which recombines familiar objects, layouts, and goals into unseen task configurations along spatial, object, and goal dimensions. blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , while most baselines exceed 94% on LIBERO-ID, this in-distribution performance does not transfer to generalization. On LIBERO-Pro, VLA baselines drop to at most 11.0% overall, whereas VPP2 reaches 45.0%, with the largest gain on the Task perturbation (47.8% vs. 6.8%), indicating that VPP2 follows the given instruction rather than replaying memorized trajectories. On LIBERO-OOD, video-based policies such as Cosmos-Policy, Fast-WAM, and DiT4DiT reach at most 10.5%, while VPP2 achieves 63.9%, also surpassing Temporal Ratio ( Mishra et al., 2026 ) , which specifically targets this generalization gap. We attribute these gains to next-event video prediction with detailed captions, which establishes consistent mappings from instructions to future trajectories.

blocks.en: RoboDojo Benchmark. RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is a unified sim-and-real benchmark for evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies. Its simulation benchmark contains 42 bimanual tasks covering five capability dimensions: generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon execution, and open-vocabulary instruction following. We follow the official training and evaluation protocol and report both the success rate and the average score, which captures partial task progress.

blocks.zh: 5 相关工程

blocks.en:
Video Foundation Model. Video generation has advanced rapidly through latent diffusion models ( Blattmann et al., 2023b ; Blattmann et al., 2023a ) and large-scale diffusion transformer models ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ) . Large-scale bidirectional video models provide strong general-purpose video priors; even recent autoregressive generators build on pretrained bidirectional models, using them for initialization or as teachers before causal adaptation and distillation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . This motivates our strategy of first learning a generalizable video model and then adapting it for efficient prediction.
Beside training strategy, prompt enhancement is an important component in video foundation models ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, we use a VLM to produce detailed, manipulation-specific descriptions that reduce ambiguity in these mappings. After establishing this manipulation-focused video prior, we post-train the model for fixed-horizon prediction and distill it for single-step generation to support efficient action learning.

影视基金会模型. 通过潜在扩散模型(Blattmann等,2023b;Blattmann等,2023a)和大规模扩散变压器模型(Yang等,2025;Wan等,2025;Agarwal等,2025;Agarwal等,2026),视频生成迅速发展。 大型双向视频模型提供了强大的通用视频前传;即使是最近的自旋相机也建立在预先训练的双向相机模型上,在因果适应和蒸馏前使用它们或作为教师(Yin等,2025;Huang等,2025.). 这激发了我们首先学习一个通俗的视频模型,然后加以改造以有效预测的战略。
除了培训战略外,迅速增强是视频基础模型的重要组成部分(Yang等,2025;Wan等,2025)。 同样,我们使用VLM来制作详细的,操纵性的具体描述来减少这些绘图中的模糊. 在先建立这种以操控为主的视频后,我们先对固定视距预测模型进行训练,再将其分馏为单步生成,以支持高效的动作学习.

blocks.en: World Action Model. World action models (WAMs) leverage video prediction to facilitate robot policy learning. Early approaches first generate future frames and then infer actions through inverse dynamics ( Du et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2023 ; Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ) , but iterative video generation can incur substantial latency for closed-loop control. Hierarchical approaches also combine video-based motion planning with reactive VLA control ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) . More recent approaches condition actions on features from video models ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026b ) or jointly learn visual prediction and action generation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Motubrain Team et al., 2026 ) . Recent work also explores event-grounded world-action learning ( Li et al., 2026b ) and large-scale manipulation-specific pretraining ( AgiBot Research Team et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, action learning can compromise pretrained capabilities, including video-model generalization ( Mishra et al., 2026 ) and VLM semantic understanding ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . VPP2 emphasizes instruction-aligned future prediction, combining event-level pretraining with detailed captions, fixed-horizon post-training, and single-step distillation to provide an efficient video backbone for action learning.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式。 世界行动模型(WAMs)利用视频预测,为机器人政策学习提供方便. 早期方法首先产生出未来的帧并再通过反向动态推断出动作(Du等,2023;Black等,2023;Bharadhwaj等,2024;Liang等,2024;Feng等,2025;),但迭接相机视频生成会引发大量闭路控制. 分级方法还结合了以视频为基础的运动规划与被动VLA控制(张等,2026e. 更近期的处理方法以视频模型的特征为条件采取行动(Hu等,2024;Liao等,2025;Yan等,2026b)或共同学习视觉预测和行动生成(Zhang等,2025;Guo等,2024;Li等,2025;Zhu等,2025;Ma等,2026;Kim等,2026;Yan等,2026a;Ye等,2026;Li等,2026a; Bi等, 2026; Motubrain Team等, 2026). 最近的工作还探索了以事件为基础的世界行动学习(Li等,2026b)和大规模操控特定预训(AgiBot Research Team等,2026). 尽管如此,动作学习可能损害预先训练的能力,包括视频-模型通论(Mishra等,2026年)和VLM语义理解(Zhang等,2026年a). 。 。 。 。 VPP2强调教学与未来预测相匹配,将事件级别预训与详细的字幕,固定视距后训练,单步分馏相结合,为动作学习提供高效的视频骨干.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a world action model that achieves strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. We first continue pretraining the base video model to produce generalizable, instruction-following predictions, then learn a policy while preserving these predictive capabilities. Experiments show that VPP2 follows manipulation instructions more faithfully than substantially larger video foundation models, exhibits strong zero-shot manipulation capabilities on a real-world ALOHA platform, and achieves the highest success rates when post-train on challenge benchmarks. We hope these findings encourage future WAM research to look beyond architectural choices for action modeling and place greater emphasis on learning generalizable video predictions and preserving this generalization during action learning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了视频预测政策2(VPP2),这是一种世界行动模式,在视频预测和动作生成两方面都实现了强烈的零镜头概括. 首先,我们继续预先培训基本视频模型,以产生可概括的、遵循教学的预测,然后在保留这些预测能力的同时学习一项政策。 实验显示,VPP2比实质性更大的视频基础模型更忠实地遵循了操控指令,在现实世界ALOHA平台上展现出强大的零发操控能力,并在挑战基准训练后取得最高成功率. 我们希望这些结论鼓励未来的WAM研究超越建筑选择来建立行动模型,更加重视学习通俗的视频预测,并在行动学习中保持这种通俗化.

blocks.en: After segmentation, we use a VLM to generate detailed captions for each clip according to a predefined template. Our captioning pipeline aims to reduce uncertainty in future prediction and encourage consistent mappings from semantic descriptions to visual trajectories. Specifically, we address four major sources of uncertainty:
blocks.zh: 分出后,我们使用一个VLM来根据预定义的模板生成每个片段的详细标题. 我们的描述管道旨在减少未来预测中的不确定性,并鼓励从语义描述到视觉轨迹的一致绘图. 具体地说,我们处理四个不确定因素:

blocks.en: (1) Detailed Task Description. We describe how the end effector completes the task, including the sequence and manner of manipulation.

blocks.en: (2) Explicit End-Effector Identification. The active end effector must be visible in the first frame; otherwise, we trim the clip to begin when it first becomes visible. When multiple end effectors are involved, we describe the motion of each one explicitly.
blocks.zh: (2)明确最终效果鉴定. 活性末端效应器必须在第一个帧中可见;否则,我们修剪剪剪接头,以便在它第一次可见时开始. 当涉及到多端效应器时,我们清晰地描述了每一个的动作.

blocks.en: (3) Unambiguous Target-Object Specification. When multiple identical or similar objects are present, we identify the target using distinctive attributes or spatial relationships. The target object must also be visible in the first frame.
blocks.zh: (3) 无矛盾的目标-目标规格。 当存在多个相同或类似的物体时,我们用不同的属性或空间关系来识别目标. 目标对象还必须在第一帧可见.

blocks.en: (4) Camera-View Description. We use optical flow to remove egocentric clips with excessive viewpoint changes. For clips with moderate camera motion, a VLM describes the viewpoint changes and the camera views included in the video, and we incorporate this information into the caption.
blocks.zh: (4)相机-视频描述. 我们使用光学流去除自取自取的片段,过度的视线变化. 对于带有中度相机运动的片段,一个VLM描述画面中包含的视角变化和相机视图,我们把这个信息纳入字幕.

blocks.en: RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026 ) evaluates generalist manipulation policies on 42 bimanual simulation tasks organized into five capability dimensions. Generalization tests robustness to unseen backgrounds, lighting, clutter, and target objects, and is evaluated under both standard and randomized settings. Precision requires fine-grained target localization and contact-rich control. Long-Horizon requires completing all sub-steps of multi-step tasks. Memory contains tasks whose correct actions depend on information observed earlier in the episode. Open evaluates unseen task specifications whose required skills appear in the training data under different contexts. We follow the official training and evaluation protocol. The average score captures partial task progress, and the success rate measures binary task completion.
